scope: User-authorized delivery of the consolidated charter, small-change workflow and bounded documentation checks through one GitHub PR with hosted CI and independent review. No merge, automatic deduplication/archive, whole-repo gate, source deletion, version release or production action.
history_strategy: New isolated history from attribution assembly plus approved 25-file scope. Original complete histories, candidates and backups remain private; never push their refs wholesale.
limitations: Pattern scanning is not proof of absence of every secret or personal datum. Media rights/content and transitive runtime compliance are not certified.
Local-address and historical workstation path references remain source context, not active configuration or permission to connect.
No production, device or human handoff acceptance, or branch-protection configuration verification. Hosted GitHub CI evidence is recorded in the M4D migration log.
Historical coverage remains bounded:85 priority files read;86 full,1 partial,407 unread unique bodies overall. Not complete factual or rights certification.
Jison Lex complete native license text was not located in the bounded evidence search; known MIT label and author retained.
Scope decision does not license third-party material or certify every transitive runtime obligation.

scope_decisions.result: External article replaced by original summary; six images excluded from reachable candidate history.
18 selected historical originals private only; known snippets and templates attributed. Remaining mixed material is not declared wholly original or fully rights-certified.
User selected retention with assembled original notices and known Jison Lex full-native-text gap. No complete regeneration or universal compliance claim.
No new project-wide open-source license. Preserve existing component licenses and third-party exceptions; this scope choice is not a blanket ownership representation.

allowed_actions: push verified charter, small-change and bounded-document-check candidate together
create or update one delivery PR
independent full-diff review bound to final exact head
remote_authorization.permitted_followups: Necessary delivery metadata, dependency guidance or CI corrections require validation and independent review on the final exact head.
excluded_actions: merge the PR or enable auto-merge
delete old repositories, private backups or historical receipts
